name: fast-link-monorepo
description: Framework-agnostic, conversion-safe navigation and measurement system for paid-traffic landing pages

scripts.build:client: bun build client/src/index.ts --outfile client/fastlink.js --format iife --banner "/* FastLink Universal Browser Runtime v1.0.0 */" && bun build client/src/index.ts --outfile client/fastlink.min.js --format iife --minify --banner "/* FastLink Universal Browser Runtime v1.0.0 */" && cp client/fastlink.min.js skills/fast-link/assets/fastlink.min.js && mkdir -p examples/wordpress/assets && cp client/fastlink.min.js examples/wordpress/assets/fastlink.min.js
scripts.test:skills: cd skills/fast-link && bun run scripts/verify_gesture_invariants.ts && bun run scripts/prove_baseline_failure.ts && bun run scripts/run_evals.ts
scripts.test: bun run test:client && bun run test:skills
